source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether an LED connection will make the LED glow.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The LED glows in both orientations.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Long wire to battery − and short wire to battery +: glows; long wire to battery + and short wire to battery −: stays off.

intelligence.enrichment: An LED has no filament and allows current to pass through it in one direction only; it glows when its positive terminal is connected to the positive side of the battery and its negative terminal is connected to the negative side. LED terminal polarity relative to battery -> permitted current direction -> LED glows or stays off The learner correctly applies this rule: An LED has no filament and allows current to pass through it in one direction only; it glows when its positive terminal is connected to the positive side of the battery and its negative terminal is connected to the negative side. An LED is just a small lamp, so either connection direction works.
